timing: Packaging/replay/waiting gives no research-duration credit; no summing overlapping windows or treating wall time as active time.
kernel: Written arguments, bounded deterministic controls and internal review only; no fresh Lean.
assumptions: Known hard pair: n iid product-uniform route points versus m=n+1 iid Joe-law points with c=n/m and F_c(x,y)=1-(1-xy)^c.
Independent fresh/reset vectors, unchanged retention within a vector, noiseless endpoint-AND routes combined by OR; all logarithms natural.
Started-vector charging, common world-independent policy randomization and unconditional terminal correctness; fixed confidence below 1/2 for matched vector order.
The finite rule uses exact rational/integer comparisons and an eventual asymptotic guarantee only; no hidden exact real-number oracle or certified finite cutoff.
Philosophical models grant relevant content, operative ground, competence and warrant premises explicitly; symbolic or modal checks do not manufacture them.
failed_or_limited_controls: Sharp CONTROL_ATTEMPT1.log records an interrupted inefficient symbolic expansion; final coefficient-first script and exact results are preserved.
Sharp pre-freeze reviewer script differs from final author script; it is historical evidence only and is not replayed. Final reviewer author_replay matches final author bytes.
Finite controls reject zero centering, omitted collision/quantization loss, wrong threshold and invalid sufficient-bound constants; no asymptotic cutoff is certified.
Basing review required feature-level witness precision, strict logical entailment and complete-operative-basis qualification; final addendum binds exact corrected arguments.
Fourth-world and factive-ground controls limit the conditional modal argument; they do not settle real-world epistemology.
Unreachable chapter 6 and limited discovery-only candidates remain uncredited as reading.
excluded_claims: All-n finite-score deployment certificate or automatic hybrid cutoff
New modal mathematical theorem or complete cognitive naturalization
First-order recognition defeat or automatic Creator-stance revision
External peer review, independent rediscovery or empirical certification
Owner acceptance, protected integration, GitHub changes or T20 closure
